description: ol-reserved-word (issue #837, maintainer ruling #833): `local measure` is ACCEPTED even with the `geometry` profile active. `local` is a binding form rather than one of the four declaration slots (spec/grammar.md:384), and spec/grammar.md:390 makes accepting the name a MUST in every binding position, whatever profile owns the name. The renderer-backed overlay `measure` is a built-in name at a DECLARATION: data/struct-runtime/struct-reserved-word-geometry-measure pins that half for this name, and stdlib-names-are-definable pins the contrasting Geometry library case.
